pictures.author: Work2win
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 ordinary panel-side view inspected. Raised moulded square stone platform and broad steps/solid cheeks. Square reddish sandstone sanctuary, large framed side relief, projecting cornice and miniature aedicule/scroll frieze; upper tower survives as stepped irregular broken masonry. Filename calls this front, but visible face has a relief panel rather than the west doorway; not used to infer entrance facing.

pictures.author: Work2win
pictures.observations: Entire500x667 ordinary west-doorway view inspected. True dark rectangular recess/short threshold, multiple nested carved jambs and lintel, shallow upright original figure/scroll vocabulary, crowned lintel and projecting dentil cornice. Original simplified geometric motifs only; no copied deity/story images.

pictures.author: byron aihara
pictures.observations: Entire960x720 ordinary west/side view inspected to cover doorway/body and broken upper silhouette together. Tall square sanctuary, door west, framed adjoining side relief, upper moulded registers/miniature niches and uneven fragmentary cap. No restored complete shikhara or tall finial. Platform extent/corner remains partly outside frame; hidden footing and dimensions approximate.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific standing Dashavatara Temple at Deogarh: reddish sandstone square sanctuary, true recessed carved west doorway, three original simplified framed relief compositions, nested jambs/lintels, moulded cornices/miniature-aedicule/scroll rhythm and irregular broken surviving upper masonry. Raised occupied square plinth with moulded edges, approximate four centered stair approaches/cheeks and low corner footing remnants. No complete shikhara restoration, copied deity/story/text atlas or full ritual interior. Existing shared stone graphs, metric UVs/linear tints and four browser levels.
